newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on January 15:
JERUSALEM - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat completed a long-awaited accord to pull back Israeli forces from the city of Hebron and the rural West Bank.

JERUSALEM - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renounced the dream that defined and divided Israeli politics for a generation when he agreed to withdraw from most of Hebron and large parts of the rural West Bank.

WASHINGTON - The senior Democrat on the House ethics committee recused himself from the case of House Speaker Newt Gingrich, while the FBI said it has begun a criminal investigation of how an intercepted Gingrich phone call was leaked to reporters.
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton's plan to bail out the District of Columbia faced criticism from congressional Republicans and D.C. Council members.
WASHINGTON - The University of the District of Columbia is paralysed by bureaucratic bumbling, waste, brutal budget cuts and a serious threat to the school's accreditation.
BELGRADE - Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic made a major concession, validating disputed election returns that would give the opposition control of Belgrade's city government.
